about: Paid web services an agent can use straight away with wallet action=pay (x402, USDC on Base mainnet). No account, no API key: the agent wallet pays per call. Checked by this service on the date shown. Prices are the seller's and can change; set max_amount to cap what one payment may cost.
how: wallet {action:'pay', url, method, body, max_amount, wallet_key, request_id} pays it from the agent wallet and returns { status:'done', receipt:{ tx, amount, to }, resource }. wallet {action:'discover', query} lists more paid services with their price.

services.name: Browser Use — a cloud browser that does a task for you

request_body_example.task: Go to example.com and tell me the page title

services.what_you_get: A browser session id; poll GET https://x402.api.browser-use.com/api/v3/sessions/{id} until status is stopped, then read output.
services.price: Credit top-up: 1 or 5 USDC, or up to 100 USDC per payment, credited to the paying wallet and carried over. Managing a session is free.

services.name: Exa — web search for agents
services.what_you_get: Search results with titles, urls and text snippets.
